description: Source code for Mazda Miata VVT engine configuration and setup functions, including parameters for fuel tables, ignition timing, sensor inputs, and engine modes.

methods.description: Copies injector lag correction and bins into engine configuration.

methods.name: setMazdaMiata2003EngineConfigurationNaFuelRail
